install.sectionBody: Add ExpenseOS to this device and it opens like an app, with its own icon, full screen, and no address bar.
install.genericBody: You can also install ExpenseOS from your browser's own menu, under Install or Add to Home Screen.
install.iosLead: This device has no install button. The Share menu does it, in three steps.
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button — the square with an arrow pointing out of it.
install.iosStep2: The share list scrolls. Keep going past the apps and the first actions — Add to Home Screen sits well down it. Tap it.
install.iosStep3: A panel appears with the app name in it. Tap Add, then open ExpenseOS from your Home Screen.
install.iosShellLead: Open this page in Safari — on iPhone and iPad, adding a site to the Home Screen is something only Safari can do.
install.dismissedBody: You closed the install dialog, so nothing changed.
install.failedBody: Your browser did not open the install dialog, and nothing changed.
install.installedBody: Open it from your home screen or app list. It runs in its own window from now on.
